مقدمة

This document outlines equipment inspection I1, which must be preformed on yearly 
bases as indicated by Y1 in the title block.

The first draft initiated by eng. Ahmed Mohamed Bakr, tested by 
 eng. El-sayed Abd El Rehim Mohamed, reviewed by eng. Omar Hamed 
 Ebrahim, accepted by eng. Farrag Hamza Farrag, approved 
 by eng. Abdel Mohsen Abdel Ghafar: Head Sector of Kafr El-Dawar Power Station.

This document certified by eng. Mona Ahmed Al Sharqawy: head sector of 
 inspection and quality control head sector.
احتياطات السلامة

A work permit must be issued and the qualified maintenance 
 staff should carry the suitable safety category

Disconnect the power supply of the air fan motor 6 kv open the C.B and tage it 
 out
Be sure the flue gas fan is stopped and the unit shutdown
ارتداء خوذة السلامة والأحذية
Safety fence with caution works surrounding the work area is required

فحص المحمل 
في حالة التآكل الواضح، تزيد الخلوص الشعاعي

Exchange the lubricating 
material in the bearing

Control the tightness of

Check the coupling

grease gun

Isolate the dampers of the 
suction and delivery (mechanically)

sections.text:
Suction chamber هو 
مزودة بباب يتيح الدخول إلى غرفة الشفط عند الفحص أو عند 
الترجل العام للمروحة. غرف الشفط للمراوح الكبيرة 
مقسمة لأسباب النقل.

Inner bearing is 
located in the core of the regulating part and takes up radial force. It is 
cooled by air. It is possible to check the temperature of the inner bearing by 
means of a built - in thermometer the inner bearing is shown on fig 1
الشكل 1

Outer bearing is 
fastened on the stand of the suction chamber, it takes up mainly axial force the 
bearing covers of large fans are provided with holes enabling the connection of 
the resistance thermometer fig 2 is the bearing of fans sizes 1000 - 1800
الشكل 2

When taking off the 
bearing case (3) with rear lid (5) remove the thermometer (10) and lubricating 
pipe (12). To disconnect the thermometer, it is necessary to pull away the 
cooling pipe of the shaft, eventually even the shaft

The assembly of the new 
bearing is performed according to assembly regulations for fan bearings. Before 
fitting the bush and bearing onto the conical pin. The new bearing must be 
secured against sliding with a securing ring. The bearing body and lid must be 
cleaned and the lid filled with new grease.
The pulling of the bush onto the pin is performed by tightening the nut (7)
It is recommended to lubricate the thread on the shaft pin with molyka or 
graphite paste (the listed lubricants must not get on the contact area of the 
conical pin of the shaft). After thoroughly tightening the nut, secure it 
against becoming unscrewed

After assembling the 
bearing test the tightness of the run by turning. The disassembled-parts of the 
inner bearing are shown on fig 3

sections.text: الشكل 3

After disassembling the 
outer bearing, slide the electric motor to the proper distance and pull the 
coupling or belt pulley from the pin of the fan shaft

At the inspection and 
exchange of the outer bearing lubricated with oil - fig. 2 (bearings of larger 
fans) you must first let out the oil (screw 12) through the hole in the lower 
part of the lid. After taking off the front lid (3) and ring (5) loosen the nut 
which fastens, bush and strike the auxiliary pipe to loosen the bush. After 
loosening the nut which fastens the bearing case to the stand flange pull, the 
bearing case (2) with the bearings and screwed on rear lid (4) from the shaft 
pin. After rinsing or exchanging the bearing slide the rear ring (6) case 
bearing with fastening bush and case onto the shaft slightly lighten nuts which 
fasten the case to the flange of the stand, then fasten the bearing with the nut 
of the fastening bush secure the nuts and tighten (the nuts which fasten the 
bearing case thoroughly) put on the front ring and fasten the lid with screws.
Clean the joint between the case and lids and renew the packing with hermetic 
before assembly. After assembling the bearing fill it with oil so that the level 
would reach to the center of the oil gauge and test the light run of the bearing 
by turning the shaft. The disassembled outer bearing of larger fans is shown on 
fig 4

Before dismounting the 
bearing mark the individual joints with a symbol (groove) and perform the 
mounting so that the symbol would be on the same place on both parts

After mounting secure the 
position of the case of the outer bearing by pinning in

When exchanging the 
bearing it is necessary to discover the cause of the damage and eliminate it in 
order to prevent the premature damaging of the new bearing .
